title: Glass Myth Busted
hook: You've been lied to about your windows
script: You've been lied to about your windows. What if you waited a thousand years for a window to droop and pool at the bottom? Old windows look thicker at the base. But that's not because the glass is flowing. Those uneven old windows were made by hand. Glass is an amorphous solid, not a liquid. It won't change shape over time. But here's the even wilder part: those old windows were installed heavy-side-down, which is why they look thicker at the base. You could watch every human civilization rise and fall 80,000 times, and the glass would still be the same shape. Save this so you remember it. You've been lied to about your windows.
